news.title: Urvashi Rautela Moves Legally Against Los Angeles AI Firm
news.summary: Actress Urvashi Rautela has reportedly sought ₹7,000 crores in damages from an anonymous Los Angeles-based artificial intelligence company. Her legal team stated that the firm utilized her name, pictures, and videos commercially without permission. This action follows a trend of Indian celebrities seeking court interventions to safeguard their personality rights.

news.title: Jr NTR Adds Star Power at Dont Trouble The Trouble Event
news.summary: Jr NTR graced the pre-release celebration of Dont Trouble The Trouble as the chief guest, shining a spotlight on the upcoming film. He also commended lead actor Fahadh Faasil and director Sashank Yeleti ahead of the film's October 2nd release.

news.title: Emotional Reunion Unfolds at Rajamouli's Family Film Event

news.title: Director and Lead Star Respond to The Paradise Controversial Mother-Daughter Dialogue
news.summary: Actor Nani and director Srikanth Odela have addressed audience criticism regarding a controversial dialogue in their ongoing film The Paradise. In the scene, a mother watches her daughter Subbu, played by Kayadu Lohar, perform in a B-grade film and praises her as a single-take actress. Srikanth Odela explained that the line reflects a mother expressing sudden amazement at her daughter's hidden talent, while Nani acknowledged that the emotional pay-off faltered due to a weak setup.

news.title: Actor Nani Expresses Gratitude at Telangana Shrine Following Box Office Success
news.summary: Following the strong theatrical run of his latest mass action entertainer The Paradise, lead star Nani and his production team journeyed to the Medaram Sammakka-Saralamma shrine. Fans gathered in large numbers at the location, with photographs of the visit quickly spreading online.
